Lemma
[Jacobi identity in cyclic form]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-3-jacobi ↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-3-antisymm

1. ch0:5.3For differentiable vector fields $X,Y,Z$ one has the cyclic Jacobi identity $[[X,Y],Z]+[[Y,Z],X]+[[Z,X],Y]=0$.
Proof

\sketch

Anticommutativity (section 4) rewrites each outer bracket as $[[X,Y],Z]=-[Z,[X,Y]]$, so the cyclic sum equals $-\big([Z,[X,Y]]+[X,[Y,Z]]+[Y,[Z,X]]\big)$. The Leibniz-form identity $[X,[Y,Z]]=[[X,Y],Z]+[Y,[X,Z]]$ of section 4, together with $[X,Z]=-[Z,X]$, makes the parenthesized derivation sum vanish, giving $0$.

□
